end.summary:
Discussed festivals across India, including Diwali and Pongal.
Kavya identified Diwali with lights, sweets, diyas and crackers.
Kavya shared that barfi and mathri are made at home for Diwali.
Pongal’s crop connection and sweet dish remained unclear; the lesson ended when Kavya asked to stop.
end.parentNote: Kavya practised using festival clues such as lights, sweets, diyas and crops. They clearly shared several Diwali details and connected Diwali with barfi and home decorations. The Diwali–Pongal clues became mixed up and were not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, use a two-column chart with one picture and one key clue for Diwali and Pongal, then ask Kavya to match them.
